en.title: Upload designs
en.subtitle: Drop your designs, automation does the rest
en.drop.title: Drag your designs here

en.steps.title: Automatically, for every design
en.steps.note: Nothing is published on its own; everything goes up as a draft

en.pending.sub: {n} designs · each becomes a draft when you press Start
en.pending.remove: Remove from the list (moved to the archive folder)

en.review.title: Designs to check
en.review.intro: A request went to Etsy for these designs, but the result is uncertain or the draft is incomplete. To avoid a second draft, etsyotomasyon never retries them on its own, and never retries one that has a draft.
en.review.retry_msg: Look at your drafts on Etsy first. If this design already has a draft, trying again creates a second one.
en.upload.title: Uploading
en.upload.known_n: {n} files were made into drafts before and will be skipped
en.upload.too_many: At most {n} files at once; the first {n} were taken.

en.folders.designs_sub: Each image gets its own draft and is placed on your mockups.
en.folders.products_sub: The folder's finished photos go into one draft, in file name order (01, 02…).
en.folders.big: Files in folders with more than {n} images go in as separate designs.
en.ready.title: {n} designs ready
en.ready.dry_hint: Prepares and checks every design without creating drafts.
en.ready.junk: {n} designs will be skipped: no product name in the file name, or too many images in the folder.

en.ready.quota: This may need more than your daily Etsy allowance; some of it may wait until tomorrow.

en.blocked.running: A run is already in progress.
en.blocked.empty: There are no new designs to draft. Drop designs here or add them to the folder.
en.unlock.title: Remove the lock?
en.unlock.msg: The lock stops two runs from creating drafts at the same time. Remove it only if no other etsyotomasyon window and no 'etsyotomasyon drop auto' is running.

en.run.sub: Every design goes through 6 steps · {n} designs at a time

en.problem.draft_refused: Etsy did not accept the draft
en.problem.draft_uncertain: Result uncertain — check the draft on Etsy
en.warn.no_market_data: No market data; tags come from the file name and the template
en.warn.no_mockups: No mockups turned on; flat design only
en.warn.flat_failed: The flat design could not be made
en.warn.convert_failed: {name} could not be converted for Etsy
en.warn.transparent_photos: {n} transparent files in the folder went up as they are
en.warn.no_shipping_profile: No shipping profile; add one before publishing
en.warn.measure_not_sent: Weight/size not sent to Etsy (0 or no unit)
en.warn.partial: The draft exists, but an image, a file or an option is missing
en.notify.stopped: The draft run stopped · {n} drafts sent
en.notify.failed: The draft run could not start
en.job.title: Preparing drafts
en.errors.not_image: This file cannot be read: it is not an image or it was only partly copied (PNG or JPG expected).
en.errors.locked: Another run is in progress or stopped halfway.
en.errors.already_drafted: This design already has a draft.
en.pending.sub_one: 1 design · it becomes a draft when you press Start
en.review.note_one: 1 design has a half-made draft or an uncertain result. Check it on Etsy.
en.upload.known_n_one: 1 file was made into a draft before and will be skipped
en.ready.junk_one: 1 design will be skipped: no product name in the file name, or too many images in the folder.
en.done.sub_errors_one: 1 design could not be sent · the reason is in the table below · none of the sent drafts were published
en.notify.stopped_one: The draft run stopped · 1 draft sent
en.blocked.junk_only: No product name can be read from the waiting designs' file names. Rename them to say what they are (for example retro-mountain-sunset.png).
en.errors.template_gone: The template listing is no longer on Etsy. Choose a new one on the Template listing page.
en.chip.mockup_hint: Choose which mockups are used, and in which order, on the Mockups page. Etsy allows at most 20 images per listing (1 is the flat design).
en.ready.mockups_over: The first {n} of {on} switched-on mockups will be used — Etsy allows at most 20 images per listing (1 is the flat design).
en.ready.mockups_over_info: The first {n} of {on} switched-on mockups will be used — Etsy allows at most 20 images per listing (1 flat design + {info}).
en.ready.info_cut: {n} product folders have many photos: only the info images that fit within Etsy's 20 pictures are added.
en.ready.info_cut_one: 1 product folder has many photos: only the info images that fit within Etsy's 20 pictures are added.
en.errors.too_many_pixels: Too large: {width}×{height} px. Images can be at most {max_edge} px on a side and {max_mp} million pixels; make it smaller and upload it again.
en.leave.title: Upload in progress
en.leave.msg: {done} of {total} files are uploaded. If you leave, the upload stops halfway; you can drop the rest again later.
en.ready.wait_upload: You can start once the upload is done
en.blocked.locked_stale: An earlier run stopped halfway: the process that held the lock is no longer running. You can remove the lock and go on.
en.blocked.locked_active: Another etsyotomasyon or a 'drop auto' in a terminal is creating drafts right now (process {pid}). Wait for it to finish.
en.unlock.active_msg: The process that holds the lock ({pid}) still seems to run on this computer. If it is a etsyotomasyon or a 'drop auto', removing the lock can make two drafts of the same design. Remove it only if you are sure that process is not etsyotomasyon.
en.errors.lock_active: The process that holds the lock is still running.
en.review.problem.partial: The draft exists, but an image, a file or an option is missing. Open the draft and finish it on Etsy.
en.review.problem.drafted: Etsy created the draft, but whether it was finished is unknown. Open the draft and check it.
en.review.problem.uncertain: The request reached Etsy but no answer came back: a draft may exist. Look at your drafts on Etsy.
en.problem.too_many_pixels: {name} is too large: {width}×{height} px. Images can be at most {max_edge} px on a side and {max_mp} million pixels; make it smaller
en.problem.invalid_title: The title does not meet Etsy's rules — rename the file
en.warn.shrunk: {name} was {mb} MB; made smaller for Etsy's 20 MB limit
en.warn.title_cleaned: Characters Etsy does not accept were taken out of the title
en.folders.downloads: {n} download files (from 'dosyalar' folders) go up with their products.
en.folders.downloads_one: {n} download file (from a 'dosyalar' folder) goes up with its product.
en.chip.type_download_hint: The template listing is a digital product: each draft gets its design file as the download, and needs no shipping profile. Change it on Template listing.
en.chip.type_both_hint: The template listing is physical and digital: drafts ship, and the design file is attached as a download too. Change it on Template listing.
en.ready.type_download_sub: the design file is attached as the download
en.ready.type_both_sub: shipped, and the design file is attached as a download too
en.ready.type_folders: Product folders: the files in their 'dosyalar' subfolder are attached (up to {max}, 20 MB each); the photos come from the folder itself.
en.ready.deliverables: {n} products have a missing or unusable download file: they stop at the Check step and get no draft.
en.ready.deliverables_one: {n} product has a missing or unusable download file: it stops at the Check step and gets no draft.
en.problem.no_deliverable: No download file: put the files buyers download in a '{folder}' subfolder
en.problem.nested_files: '{folder}' has subfolders ({folders}): Etsy takes files, not folders, so zip each subfolder (or the whole set) into one file
en.problem.download_is_photo: {name} would be both a listing photo and the file buyers download; anyone could save it from the listing
en.problem.too_many_files: {n} download files; Etsy takes {max} per listing, so zip them into one
en.problem.file_too_large: {name} is {mb} MB; Etsy takes digital files up to {max_mb} MB, so make it smaller or split it
en.problem.file_type: {name} can't be sold as a download (a program, or no extension)
en.problem.no_photos: This product has no photos, only its '{folder}' folder: put the product's photos (01, 02, ...) in the '{name}' folder itself
en.ready.no_photos: {n} product folders have no photos, only 'dosyalar': they stop at the Check step and get no draft.
en.ready.no_photos_one: {n} product folder has no photos, only 'dosyalar': it stops at the Check step and gets no draft.
en.blocked.photos_only: The waiting product folders have no photos. Every listing needs at least one: put the product's photos (01, 02, ...) in the product folder itself, next to its 'dosyalar' folder.
en.warn.partial_files: Draft created, but the download file ({name}) did not go up; add it in Etsy before publishing
en.warn.made_to_order_no_file: Made to order: no download file attached; add the buyer's file in Etsy once it is made
en.warn.not_shipped: Digital product: the template's shipping settings were not sent
en.errors.not_deliverable: This file can't be sold as a download (a program, or no extension).
en.errors.reserved_folder: A product folder cannot be named 1-MOCKUPS, 2-PRODUCTS or 3-DRAFTS; rename it, or upload its images as separate designs.
en.errors.not_digital: The template listing is a physical product, so no download files are taken; a 'dosyalar' folder is only for a digital template.
en.errors.section_gone: The shop section you picked no longer exists on Etsy. The list was read again; pick another section.
en.upload.downloads_skipped: {n} download files were not uploaded: files in a 'dosyalar' folder go up only with "Every folder is one product".
en.upload.downloads_skipped_one: {n} download file was not uploaded: files in a 'dosyalar' folder go up only with "Every folder is one product".
en.upload.nested_downloads: {n} files were not uploaded: they sit in subfolders of 'dosyalar'. Etsy takes files, not folders; zip each subfolder and put the zip in 'dosyalar'.
en.upload.nested_downloads_one: {n} file was not uploaded: it sits in a subfolder of 'dosyalar'. Etsy takes files, not folders; zip the subfolder and put the zip in 'dosyalar'.
en.blocked.deliverables_only: None of the waiting products has a usable download file. For product folders, put the files buyers download in a 'dosyalar' subfolder (up to 5 files, 20 MB each).
en.pending.show_hint: Show the designs waiting in the folder
en.side.stage.title: Writing the title
en.warn.as_is: No transparent background: not placed on the mockups, uploaded as it is
en.warn.small_image: {name} is {px} px on its short side: it may look soft on Etsy (2000 px or more is recommended)
en.warn.info_images_cut: Only the first {n} of the {total} info images fit: with the product's own photos the listing reaches Etsy's limit of {max} pictures
en.warn.design_small: The design is small for the print area (enlarged {factor}×): it may look soft on the mockups
en.ready.main_mismatch: Template: {template}, main image: {main}. Change the main image on Mockups.
en.ready.digital_physical: Digital template: {n} of the switched-on mockups show a physical product ({types}); these drafts leave them out.
en.ready.digital_physical_one: Digital template: 1 switched-on mockup shows a physical product ({types}); these drafts leave it out.
en.ready.digital_flat_only: No poster or frame mockup is switched on: only the flat preview goes up.
en.ready.opaque_as_is: {n} files without a transparent background will not go onto the mockups; they are uploaded as they are.
en.ready.opaque_as_is_one: 1 file without a transparent background will not go onto the mockups; it is uploaded as it is.
en.ready.opaque_place: {n} designs on a solid background get that background removed and go onto the mockups.
en.ready.opaque_place_one: 1 design on a solid background gets that background removed and goes onto the mockups.
en.ready.opaque_photos: {n} photos are uploaded as they are.
en.ready.opaque_photos_one: 1 photo is uploaded as it is.
en.ready.opaque.place_sub: The solid background is removed and the design goes onto every mockup
en.ready.opaque.as_is_sub: Each file goes up as it is, as one picture
en.ready.wm_not_this: this template is physical, none is added
en.blocked.watermark: The watermark file cannot be read; nothing starts, so no photo goes up without it. Upload it again on the Mockups page, or switch it off.
en.problem.watermark_failed: The watermark could not be put on {name}; it was not sent without it
en.warn.description_design: The description still has {n} sentences about the template listing's own design ({words}); edit the description template on Template listing
en.warn.description_design_one: The description still has 1 sentence about the template listing's own design ({words}); edit the description template on Template listing
en.ready.description_flagged: The template listing's description has {n} sentences about its own design; they are copied onto every draft.
en.ready.description_flagged_one: The template listing's description has 1 sentence about its own design; it is copied onto every draft.
en.ready.section_empty: Your shop has no sections, so the drafts get none. You can add sections in Etsy's Shop Manager.
en.ready.section_unavailable: The shop's sections could not be read right now: the drafts go into the template's section.
en.ready.section_template_gone: The template listing's section is no longer in your shop: the drafts get no section. Pick one if you like.
en.ready.section_remembered_gone: The section you picked last time ({name}) is no longer in your shop; the template's is used.
